tools.name: getAvailability
tools.description:
Returns the availability adjustments overview page for all clients. Requires Spectrum authorization.

(GET /availability)

tools.name: getAvailabilityDetails
tools.description:
Returns product set pricing and availability adjustments for a single client. Requires a valid API token for the client.

(GET /availability/details/{clientHandle})

tools.name: getSavedAssetsForOrganization
tools.description:
Return a pageable list of saved uploaded assets for a client's organization identifier.

(GET /api/assets/saved/client/{clientHandle}/organization/{clientIdentifier})

includeUploadedAssets.description: Include full uploaded asset details. Defaults to false.

pageSize.description: Page size. Omit to disable paging.

tools.name: getSavedAsset
tools.description:
Return a single saved uploaded asset by its numeric ID.

(GET /api/assets/saved/{id})

tools.name: getGeneratedRecipeSetImage
tools.description:
Generate (or return a cached) rendered image of a customized recipe set from a given view angle. Optional path/query segments allow specifying render state, camera, dimensions and caching. Additional query-string parameters control image manipulation (see the Image QueryString API docs).

(GET /api/assets/generated/recipeset/readable/{readableId}/{viewAngleHandle})

useCache.description: Whether to use the render cache. Defaults to true.
